TANK-01.Setpoint within 35..max supply (60); at most +3 K per 15 min

LuxSetpoint >= 300 while occupied; 0 only when unoccupied
HP-01.MaxFraction < 1 refused while TANK-01.Temp < Setpoint - 2 K

rate: at most one change per point per 15 min; setpoints move <= 1.0 K per change

procedures.name: Zone setback and recovery
procedures.why: the interlock moves at most 1 K per change and twice per hour, and the deadband (IL-01) means the cooling setpoint must move first when heating rises toward it
steps: raising: if HeatingSetpoint + delta > CoolingSetpoint - 2, raise CoolingSetpoint first
move HeatingSetpoint in <= 1.0 K steps, >= 15 min apart
lowering: move HeatingSetpoint down in steps; CoolingSetpoint may follow afterwards
verify AirTemp reaches the band before occupancy (optimal start computes the lead)

procedures.name: AHU night shutdown and morning start
procedures.why: stopping ventilation while people are present is not allowed (IL-06), and a cold start blows cold air if the supply setpoint is low
steps: check every zone's Occupants = 0 and none expected within 30 min
set_ahu_enabled(true) >= 30 min before occupancy; verify CO2 < 800 ppm at start

procedures.name: Load shift by tank pre-charge
procedures.why: stored heat moves consumption to cheap hours, but a hotter tank lowers COP and nears the high-pressure limit
steps: raise TANK-01.Setpoint in <= 3 K steps toward <= 55 degC during cheap hours
never combine with an HP-01.MaxFraction cap below 1.0
lower TANK-01.Setpoint back to the curve requirement before the expensive block ends
verify HP-01.HighPressureCutout stayed 0 and HP-01.Starts rose by <= 3 per hour

procedures.name: Demand-response cap
procedures.why: capping the compressor while the tank is short starts the backup heater, which costs about COP times more than the heat it replaces
steps: release (1.0) as soon as TANK-01.Temp < Setpoint - 3 or the cap window ends
verify HP-01.BackupHeaterPower stayed 0 during the cap

procedures.name: Heating-cable price deferral
procedures.why: a ramp without heat in icing conditions is a safety hazard; only a dry, short deferral is acceptable
steps: only CABLE-RAMP, only when no precipitation is forecast during the deferral
defer at most 1 h into a cheaper hour; never during OUT-01.IcingRisk
the interlock turns the circuit on when the deferral expires (IL-10)

cascades.consequence: a zone change draws the shared tank down; several zones at once can push it 5 K below target and start the backup heater at COP 1

cascades.trigger: cap HP-01.MaxFraction for a price peak
cascades.consequence: the cap saves only if the tank holds; otherwise the backup heater costs more than the compressor would have (PR-04, IL-09)
